title: Human Action Request (HAR)
description: Durable human action request for MANUAL gate conditions and work handoffs. The wait IS the artifact.

har_id.description: Unique identifier for this human action request

state.description: Current state of the human action request

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the HAR was created

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last state change

expires_at.description: Optional expiration timestamp. If reached and state is OPEN, becomes STALE.

answered_at.description: Timestamp when the HAR was answered

answered_by.description: Identity of who answered the HAR

owner.description: Owner of the HAR (who created it or is responsible)

requested_action.description: High-level description of what action is being requested

conditions.description: List of MANUAL condition IDs this HAR is waiting for

context_frozen.description: Frozen snapshot of context at creation time. The exact context the human saw when deciding.

resume.description: Instructions to resume work after human response. Contains everything needed to rehydrate the execution context.

command.description: Command to execute to resume work

model.description: Model identifier used for the work (e.g., 'gpt-4', 'claude-3-opus')

env.description: Environment variables needed to resume (non-secret config only). Secrets handled separately.

recovery.description: Recovery and handoff information for handoff scenarios

handoff.description: Handoff notes for the next person/agent picking up this work

answer.description: The human's answer/decision when the HAR is answered
